nodes.name: analyze-creator-baselines.py
nodes.summary: Side-hustles niche analysis script that separates content-quality signals from creator-authority signals by measuring whether videos outperform their creator's own DPS baseline, joining training_features to scraped_videos.
nodes.languageNotes: Single 549-line main() drives the entire report; uses scipy.stats spearmanr/mannwhitneyu and pandas for ranked correlation between raw DPS and creator-relative DPS.

nodes.name: analyze-feature-correlations.py
nodes.summary: Ranked feature-to-DPS correlation analysis that produces a definitive Spearman/Mann-Whitney report identifying which training_features actually predict real DPS scores from scraped_videos.
nodes.languageNotes: Mixes continuous (Spearman) and binary (Mann-Whitney) tests, with mega-vs-under and duration-bucket sub-analyses; emits a 140-line markdown report builder.

nodes.name: analyze-one-video.ts
nodes.summary: CLI utility that takes a single video URL/path and prints FFmpeg-derived visual metrics plus a DPS visual sub-score, used as a quick smoke test for the visual-intelligence pipeline.

nodes.name: analyze-post-pub-signals.py
nodes.summary: Read-only observational study of post-publication engagement signals (views, likes, shares, saves, sound origin, posting time) on side-hustles shorts, explicitly walled off from prediction features.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents an explicit contamination boundary in the module docstring; main() is 583 lines and drives the entire markdown report build.

nodes.name: analyze-response-stacks.py
nodes.summary: Classifies side-hustles videos into share-heavy / save-heavy / comment-heavy / shallow-view response stacks and surfaces which pre-pub content signals predict each audience reaction pattern.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest script in the batch (855 lines, main() = 673); uses regex caption_signals() to pull lexical features and joins to training_features for content-side correlation.

nodes.summary: Computes what separates each DPS tier from the next using Mann-Whitney across 863 side-hustle videos, producing the TIER_ANALYSIS_REPORT.md with directional advice per feature.
nodes.languageNotes: Excludes account-bias and proxy features from TOP_FEATURES list to keep tier guidance content-driven.
